profiles.shortDescription: TrojanUV is Trojan Technologies' municipal ultraviolet water-treatment brand. Its official portfolio covers UV disinfection and advanced oxidation systems for drinking water, wastewater, remediation and water reuse.
fullDescription: Trojan Technologies presents TrojanUV as a current product brand for municipal water and wastewater treatment. The documented range includes open-channel and closed-vessel UV systems for drinking water, wastewater and reuse, together with UV advanced oxidation solutions for chemical-contaminant remediation.

profiles.shortDescription: Trommelberg supplies equipment for automotive workshops, tyre service and vehicle body repair. Its official catalogue includes lifts, wheel-service machines, diagnostic systems and workshop tools.
fullDescription: The manufacturer-owned Trommelberg site documents workshop equipment for vehicle maintenance and repair. The range spans lifting systems, tyre changers and wheel balancers, alignment and diagnostic equipment, air-conditioning service stations, body-repair systems and supporting workshop tools.

profiles.shortDescription: TROX develops and manufactures components, units and systems for room ventilation and air conditioning. Its portfolio includes air-handling units, air-distribution components, filtration, fire-protection and control systems.
fullDescription: TROX's official company information defines its scope as ventilation and air-conditioning technology for rooms and buildings. Manufacturer documentation covers central air-handling units, air-distribution components, filters, fire and smoke-control products, sound attenuators, room-air systems and integrated controls.

profiles.shortDescription: TRUMPF develops production technology for industrial manufacturing. Its official portfolio covers machine tools, laser systems, power tools, industrial electronics and manufacturing software.
fullDescription: TRUMPF's corporate profile and product directory document manufacturing solutions for cutting, punching, bending, laser processing and connected production. The range includes machine tools and systems, industrial lasers, power tools, electronics and software used in sheet-metal processing and other industrial production tasks.

profiles.shortDescription: Tsubaki manufactures power-transmission and material-handling products. Its official business portfolio includes industrial chains, reducers, linear actuators, clutches, mobility systems and conveyor solutions.
fullDescription: Tsubakimoto Chain documents four business areas spanning power transmission, mobility, materials handling and new businesses. The industrial portfolio includes steel and plastic chains, reducers, linear actuators, clutches and engineered conveyance systems used across general industry, automotive, infrastructure and food-related applications.

profiles.shortDescription: TT Electronics engineers and manufactures electronic components and assemblies for regulated and industrial applications. Its portfolio includes sensors, passive components, power-conversion products, connectors and microelectronic assemblies.
fullDescription: TT Electronics' manufacturer-owned site presents a vertically integrated electronics portfolio ranging from individual components to engineered assemblies. Documented product groups include sensors, resistors, optoelectronics, electromagnetics, connectors, power modules and supplies, semiconductors, human-machine interfaces and hybrid microcircuits.

profiles.shortDescription: Turian manufactures rotary joints for transferring fluids between stationary and rotating equipment. Its range covers joints for water, air, vacuum, oil, steam and heat-transfer fluids.
fullDescription: Turian Eng's official catalogue presents single-flow and multi-flow rotary joints for industrial machinery. Product selections address water, compressed air, vacuum, hydraulic oil, steam and diathermic oil, with configurations for different pressures, speeds, connection sizes and flow arrangements.

profiles.shortDescription: UFI Filters develops filtration and thermal-management products for vehicles and industrial applications. Its range includes air, oil, fuel, cabin, hydraulic and coolant filters together with heat exchangers and thermal systems.
fullDescription: UFI Filters' corporate site documents filtration technology for automotive, heavy-duty, hydraulic, aerospace, marine and other technical applications. Product families include air, oil, fuel and cabin filters, hydraulic filtration components, coolant filtration and thermal-management systems for conventional and electrified vehicles.

profiles.shortDescription: ULT develops extraction and filtration systems for airborne contaminants in industrial processes. Its solutions capture dust, fumes, vapours, odours and gases from production equipment and work areas.
fullDescription: ULT's official site documents modular extraction and air-filtration equipment for laser processing, soldering, additive manufacturing, machining and other industrial operations. The systems combine collection hardware, airflow management and filter stages to remove particulate and gaseous contaminants at source.

profiles.shortDescription: Ultra Pompe manufactures positive-displacement gear pumps for industrial fluids. Its official catalogue includes cast-iron and stainless-steel configurations, close-coupled units and pumps with external bearing supports.
fullDescription: Ultra Pompe's manufacturer catalogue documents external-gear pumps for transferring lubricating and process fluids. Available constructions include cast iron and stainless steel, compact motor-coupled arrangements and externally supported pump configurations for differing viscosities, duties and installation requirements.

profiles.shortDescription: UNISIGN develops and manufactures CNC machining centres for industrial production. Its machine range supports milling, drilling, turning and multi-operation machining of large and complex components.
fullDescription: UNISIGN's official machine-tool material presents CNC machining centres for flexible and productive manufacturing. The documented portfolio includes vertical and horizontal configurations, portal machines and combined machining solutions for sectors such as aerospace, energy, transport, general engineering and heavy equipment.

profiles.shortDescription: Unistrut is Atkore's engineered metal-framing and support-system brand. Its portfolio covers strut channels, fittings, fasteners, hangers, pipe clamps, concrete inserts and seismic bracing components.
fullDescription: Atkore's official brand page defines Unistrut as a weldless, adjustable framing and support system. The range includes channels and fittings, fastening hardware, pipe supports, fiberglass systems, concrete inserts and seismic bracing solutions for mechanical, electrical and building-services installations.

profiles.shortDescription: Unitronics develops industrial automation hardware, software and IIoT solutions. Its range includes PLCs with integrated HMI, I/O modules, variable-frequency drives, servo drives and machine-control software.
fullDescription: Unitronics' official company page documents integrated control products for machines and process automation. The portfolio combines PLC and HMI controllers, distributed I/O, variable-frequency and servo drives, programming software and an IIoT platform for monitoring and managing automated installations.

profiles.shortDescription: USA Industries manufactures and supplies equipment for piping isolation, pressure testing and heat-exchanger maintenance. Its range includes pipe blinds, flanges, isolation and test plugs, tube plugs and flow-measurement components.
fullDescription: USA Industries' official pages document engineered products used during plant construction, shutdowns, maintenance and hydrostatic testing. The portfolio includes paddle and spectacle blinds, blind flanges, gripping and mechanical pipe plugs, heat-exchanger tube plugs, orifice plates, bleed rings and supporting maintenance tools.

profiles.shortDescription: Utilcell develops weighing components and instrumentation. Its official product range includes load cells, pin load cells, indicators, telemetry equipment and accessories for industrial weighing systems.
fullDescription: Utilcell's manufacturer-owned product directory documents components for force and weight measurement. The range spans standard and pin-type load cells, digital and analogue indicators, telemetry products, accessories and versions intended for hazardous-area weighing applications.

profiles.shortDescription: Vahterus develops and manufactures Plate & Shell heat exchangers for industrial thermal processes. Its product range supports heating, cooling, condensation and evaporation duties across process and energy applications.
fullDescription: Vahterus' official product information centres on welded Plate & Shell heat-exchanger technology. The documented portfolio covers compact units for refrigeration, chemical and process duties, energy systems, heat pumps and other applications that require heat transfer, condensation or evaporation.

profiles.shortDescription: Vaisala develops measurement instruments, systems and intelligence for weather, environmental and industrial applications. Its industrial portfolio covers humidity, temperature, dew point, carbon dioxide, pressure, liquid concentration and power-asset measurements.
fullDescription: Vaisala's official product catalogues document instruments and systems for industrial and environmental measurement. The portfolio includes probes, transmitters, handheld meters, data loggers, continuous monitoring systems, process refractometers, transformer monitoring and weather-observation equipment.

profiles.shortDescription: Valbia manufactures electric and pneumatic valve actuators and integrated actuated-valve assemblies. Its portfolio includes quarter-turn, multi-turn, positioning, fail-safe and hazardous-area actuator configurations.
fullDescription: Valbia's official site and Bonomi Group material document actuator technology for industrial flow-control applications. The range includes pneumatic and electric actuators, high-torque and multi-turn models, positioning and battery-return options, networked controls and assembled valve-actuator solutions.

profiles.shortDescription: Valeo develops automotive systems and components for electrification, driver assistance, lighting and in-vehicle experience. Its portfolio also includes thermal-management, wiper, sensing and replacement-parts technologies.
fullDescription: Valeo's official activity and technology pages organize its automotive portfolio around power and thermal systems, advanced driver assistance, vehicle lighting and interior experience. Documented products include sensors, cameras, radar and software, electric powertrain components, thermal-management modules, lighting, wiper and cleaning systems.

profiles.shortDescription: Valvaut is Effepi's brand for pneumatically actuated industrial valves. Its catalogue covers gate, globe, angle-seat, ball and butterfly valves together with pneumatic rotary actuators.
fullDescription: Effepi's official Valvaut site documents automatic valves for liquids, gases, steam and vacuum. The range includes two-way and three-way globe valves, angle-seat designs, brass and stainless-steel ball valves, butterfly valves and pneumatic actuator assemblies for process flow control.

profiles.shortDescription: Van Remmen UV Technology develops UV-C disinfection and advanced oxidation systems for water treatment. Its product series address drinking water, process water, wastewater, reuse streams and specialized industrial applications.
fullDescription: Van Remmen UV Technology's official site documents UV-C equipment for keeping water and process fluids microbiologically controlled. The range includes validated and certified disinfection systems, application-specific product series, transmission meters and Advanox advanced oxidation systems for degrading micropollutants.

profiles.shortDescription: Veeder-Root develops fuel-management and environmental-monitoring systems for storage and dispensing sites. Its portfolio includes automatic tank gauges, probes, leak-detection sensors, submersible turbine pumps and meter registers.
fullDescription: Veeder-Root's official company and product-guide pages document equipment for fuel inventory, tank compliance and forecourt operations. The range includes automatic tank gauging, probes and containment sensors, fuel-quality systems, Red Jacket submersible turbine pumps, pump controllers and mechanical or electronic meter registers.

profiles.shortDescription: VEIT manufactures machinery and systems for garment finishing and textile care. Its range includes industrial irons, pressing and fusing machines, finishing equipment, steam generators and vacuum or compressed-air systems.
fullDescription: VEIT's official company profile and product directory document equipment for ironing, pressing, fusing, laminating and refinishing garments and technical textiles. The portfolio spans manual and automated ironing systems, presses, tunnel and form finishers, fusing machines, steam supply, vacuum plants and textile-care accessories.

profiles.shortDescription: VEMAG develops machinery for filling, portioning, forming and handling food and other viscous products. Its systems include vacuum fillers, dough portioners, forming attachments and automated loading solutions.
fullDescription: VEMAG's official company and technology pages document process machinery for accurately filling and portioning viscous, pasty and chunky materials. The portfolio combines vacuum filling machines, dough portioners, grinding and forming attachments, container-filling lines and automated product handling for small-scale and industrial production.

profiles.shortDescription: Venture Industries manufactures and supplies fans and ventilation equipment for industrial, commercial and residential systems. Its range includes centrifugal, axial, duct, roof, smoke-extract and corrosion-resistant fans.
fullDescription: Venture Industries' official company and product pages document equipment for general, industrial, fire-safety and residential ventilation. The portfolio includes centrifugal and axial fans, duct and roof units, side-channel blowers, ATEX and chemical-resistant designs, air-extraction devices, heat-recovery units and ventilation controls.

profiles.shortDescription: Verder Group develops industrial and hygienic pumping solutions and laboratory equipment. Its two operating fields cover fluid handling through Verder Liquids and material analysis through Verder Scientific.
fullDescription: Verder's official business pages identify two technology businesses. Verder Liquids supplies industrial and hygienic pump solutions for fluid handling, while Verder Scientific develops laboratory and analytical equipment for sample preparation, heat treatment, particle analysis and quality control.
